name: Toolbox
description: Quality-of-life HUD and trackers. XP (session, pools, last hour; XP Detailed with levels and a chart) and Today (gold, kills, XP, every item looted, optional estimated values from shroudoftheavatar.net). Buff bar with clock sweeps, grouping and alerts; consumables bar for food and potions; health, focus and Vigor bars; combat stats with Combat Detailed; equipment repair bar; notifications (guild message, mail, ransoms, rewards, gear needing repair). Commands: /toolbox and /tbx.
author: shawn butts
